channel.name: Run 4 timing + COB with custom pad ring for a power chip (quarter slot)

messages.content:
Hey! My friend and I are high schoolers designing a hybrid buck-boost converter on GF180 (2.7–5.5V in, 5V out, ~500mA) and want to tape out on a quarter slot. A few questions:

Run 3 is too soon for us. Any idea when Run 4 will open and close, and will it have early bird pricing?
Any student discount? We’re self-funding.
The COB add-on needs the default pad ring. Is there any way to get COB bonding with a custom pad ring, even for an extra fee? Our power stage needs more power pads than the default ring has.
If we stick with the default ring: can we turn some of the signal pads into extra power/ground pads while keeping the same bond positions, so it still works with the breakout board?
Roughly how much current can one pad and one bond wire safely carry?

Thanks!
